item.title: Building a Self-Hosted Game Server Platform
item.description: This year I built a multi-instance game server platform on a bare-metal Ubuntu machine at home for me and my friends. It hosts modded Minecraft and Terraria, with each Minecraft server isolated in its own container, and everyone connects without me opening a single port on my router.

item.title: I used Obsidian everyday in 2025
item.description: At the beginning of 2025, I started using Obsidian as my primary note-taking tool. The switch to Obsidian was a lot easier than expected and has helped me organise information, track my work, and manage my daily workflow.

item.title: Migrating my domain to Cloudflare
item.description: I decided to migrate my domain from Namecheap to Cloudflare and wanted to share why I made the switch and how the process went. If you're considering a similar move, this guide should help you understand the benefits and walk through the migration process.

item.title: Self-Hosting n8n with Cloudflare Tunnels
item.description: I recently set up n8n, a powerful workflow automation platform, on my local PC and made it accessible via my custom domain using Cloudflare Tunnels. This setup gives me a secure, always-on automation platform without exposing ports or dealing with traditional VPN configurations.
